newsitem.title: USA: Ciba gets FDA approval for Diovan.
newsitem.headline: Ciba gets FDA approval for Diovan.

text.p: Ciba Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Thursday it received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market Diovan, used to treat hypertension.

Diovan will be the first new chemical product introduced by Novartis Pharmaceuticals Corp, the company formed by the merger of Ciba-Geigy Corp and Sandoz AG, Ciba said. Ciba Pharmaceuticals is a unit of Ciba-Geigy Corp.
Diovan, which would be available by the second quarter of 1997, blocked certain hormones, causing blood vessels to dilate and blood pressure to drop, the company said.
It is a first-line therapy with a recommended starting dose of 80 mg per day, the company said. It would be available by prescription in capsule form, it said.
